picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first-ever DOE Genesis Mission awards marks the launch of a major new federal initiative to apply AI directly to scientific discovery, spanning particle physics data streams to broader research acceleration.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully speed up and de-risk early drug development, a rare direct translation of AI research into medical practice.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: Using generative AI to design entirely new proteins not found in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's techniques, represents a genuine scientific leap with implications for medicine and materials science.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor analysis across cancer types could improve treatment prediction, showing how AI foundation models are beginning to reshape oncology research.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot crossing a $1 billion valuation as TUM's 23rd unicorn is a striking financial milestone that underscores the commercial momentum behind university-spawned AI startups in Europe.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM system, developed with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida, brings AI guidance directly into clinical procedures like blood draws and intubation, a concrete real-world healthcare application.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's Genesis Mission partnership with Fermilab pairs a national laboratory with academia to tackle the data deluge in high-energy physics, illustrating how the DOE initiative is bridging institutions.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built by HKU with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability, a foundational tool for the field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: DOE funding to defend AI systems managing the U.S. electric grid against adversarial cyberattacks addresses a critical infrastructure security gap as AI becomes embedded in national energy operations.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid

picks.editorial_note: A Nature Medicine study from UCL, Oxford, and the UK AI Security Institute introduces a clinically validated framework for auditing mental-health risks in AI chatbots, directly relevant to emerging AI safety regulation.
picks.title: Mapping how mental health risks emerge in AI chatbot conversations
